items.title: A morphism inducing isomorphisms of automorphism groups injects the points of a cartesian square of stacks
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a cartesian diagram of algebraic stacks in which the vertical morphism induces isomorphisms between automorphism groups at points, the induced comparison map on the isomorphism classes of points over a field is injective (author lemma at source lines 10123-10142, label lemma-stabilizer-preserving-points-cartesian). The proof (source lines 10144-10157) rewrites the assertion as the uniqueness of an object filling a given pair, describes such objects as triples using the construction of 2-fibre products, and lifts the difference of the two 2-morphisms along the assumed isomorphism of automorphism groups (proof lines 10145-10156). The lifting of the difference is the content. H2.
